fields.Name: IT166 - Predictive Shadow Scoring and Drift
fields.Description: Exercises Predictive Studio's live challenger and its monitored divergence end-to-end (deterministic, no sidecar). PSD1: a bound 'ML Model' Record Process whose ChallengerConfiguration names a challenger is scored through ScoringService; its champion and challenger predictions are Source='Model' Feature Values, each role under its own MJ: ML Scoring Runs row, with no Source='Pipeline' row. PSD2: the monitoring driver's divergence step measures the same binding's mirror over the period and stores it on the champion's MJ: ML Monitoring Results row (ChallengerResult.mirror: paired records, agreement, mean score delta, failures), read back from the row. #6180's PSI drift action is gone (PR 4 M6.8).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The champion's and the challenger's rows of a bound process are Source='Model' rows of two scoring runs (one per role) and no Pipeline row is written; the period row of the champion stores the mirror's divergence: every record paired, agreement 0 (0.3 against 0.8), mean score delta 0.5, no failures.
